## About
Perth Amboy Spring Works is a full service spring suspension shop and a family business. It goes back to a blacksmith shop that built and installed springs. Carl Venezian founded the company right in the heart of Perth Amboy, his son Joe Venezian, Sr. moved it to our current site on Sheridan Street, and Joe Venezian, Jr. later took over.
Over the years the work has grown to include all types of suspension work, and we added brake services through PA System Brake, our brake service division. Our spacious shop has up to date equipment and tools, and we service all makes and models.
Ivan Torres heads our service department and can answer your questions in English or Spanish. John Raab, known as JR, tracks down the parts we need. One reviewer mentions Ivan and JR by name, saying they took the time to explain everything.

## Services
- Spring and suspension work: Spring work and all types of suspension repair.
- Air spring replacement: Replacing worn or damaged air springs.
- Boggie rebushing: Rebushing work on boggie suspensions.
- Front end work: Front end suspension repair.
- Alignments: Alignments for 1, 2 and 3 axle vehicles.
- Lift axle installation: Installing lift axles.
- Brake service: Air, hydraulic and ABS brakes, plus brake shoe relining, riveting and exchange for industrial, commercial and marine use.
- Drums and rotors: Brake drums and rotors resurfaced.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get help in Spanish?
A: Yes. Our Service Manager Ivan Torres can help you in English or Spanish.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: All makes and models, from cars to heavy duty trucks and trailers.

Q: Can you do the work the same day?
A: Same day service is available whenever possible. Give us a call and we will let you know.

Q: What if my job is unusual?
A: For special applications, call with any questions and ask for JR or Ivan.
